system.description:
• Effect: A new Channel option, costing 2 uses: call on your deity for one of these effects.
  • (1) Right after the roll, reroll any one die result (attack, damage, save, turn undead or attribute check); you can do this out of turn
  • (2) As part of the action you use to attack: Advantage on all your attack rolls and double weapon damage dice until the end of your turn (flat modifiers are not doubled)
  • (3) When you take damage: halve it, and all further damage you take until the start of your next turn; you can do this out of turn
